name: tablecn
summary: Data table and data grid components for shadcn/ui with server-side sorting, filtering, pagination and real-time collaboration.
description: A shadcn/ui data table and data grid component set built on TanStack Table and TanStack DB. Features server-side pagination, sorting and filtering, customizable columns, filters generated from column definitions, Notion/Airtable-like advanced filtering, a Linear-like command palette filter menu, a row-selection action bar and infinite scrolling with virtualization. A separate PartyKit/PartyServer demo adds real-time multiplayer over PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM; the repository is now named tablecn and ships 13 registry items, demoed at tablecn.com.
contains: data table and data grid components built with shadcn/ui and TanStack Table
server-side pagination, sorting and filtering; auto-generated filters from column definitions
Notion/Airtable-like advanced filtering; Linear-like command palette filter menu
customizable columns; row-selection action bar; infinite scrolling with virtualization
real-time collaboration via PartyKit/PartyServer and TanStack DB
PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM; Zod validation
13 registry items; install with the shadcn CLI
